title: What happens to your brain if you sleep 6 hours a night?
description:
You feel fine on six hours of sleep. That is exactly the problem. In one well-known study, people kept to six hours a night for two weeks tested like people who had skipped sleep for up to two nights.

Source: Van Dongen et al., 2003, Sleep ("The cumulative cost of additional wakefulness").

#shorts #psychology #sleep

scenes.headline: 6 HOURS
scenes.text: What happens to your brain if you sleep only six hours a night for two weeks?

scenes.headline: FEELS FINE
scenes.label: HOW YOU FEEL
scenes.text: You feel fine. That's the trap.

scenes.label: 6 hours a night
scenes.text: In one well-known study, people limited to six hours a night for two weeks performed on attention tests like people who had skipped sleep for up to two nights.

scenes.headline: NOT AWARE
scenes.label: FOCUS
scenes.text: And they didn't feel that impaired.

scenes.headline: FOCUS SLIPS
scenes.text: Your focus slips, your reactions slow, and you don't notice.

scenes.headline: YOU CAN'T TELL
scenes.text: So what happens if you sleep six hours? You get worse, and you can't tell.
